rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; ADNI is a well-known multi-site consortium with multiple 3T MRI scanners across sites; Knight ADRC uses two scanners (Siemens Biograph mMR and Trio 3T)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "ADNI participants included in our analysis underwent T1-weighted MRI imaging using 3T MRI scanners"; "MRI data were acquired on a Siemens Biograph mMR or Trio 3T scanner."
rci1_using_msad.location: Kumar2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.2.1 Image acquisition; media-3.docx.md: SM1.1

rci2_using_epd.detail: ADNI used as reference control group (ADNI-CU) for discovery normative model training; ADNI is a confirmed EPD
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "A total of 434 amyloid-negative CU participants were included in the reference control group (ADNI-CU)"; "ADNI data used in this study are publicly available and can be requested following ADNI Data Sharing and Publications Committee guidelines"
rci2_using_epd.location: Kumar2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1 Participants; Kumar2025.pdf.md: DATA AVAILABILITY STATEMENT

rci3_epd_name.detail: ADNI-CU used for discovery model reference cohort; Knight ADRC used for replication transfer learning but is not in the EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Initially, mmVAE was trained using the ADNI-CU-train set"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase: ADNI-CU-train (n=326) used for initial model training; ADRC-CU-tl (n=225) used for transfer learning fine-tuning on replication dataset; split ratio 75:15:10 for both datasets
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The ADNI-CU group was further divided into a training set for model training (ADNI-CU-train; n = 326), a holdout validation set (ADNI-CU-holdout; n = 65), and a test set (ADNI-CU-test; n = 43) at a ratio of 75:15:10"; "the ADRC-CU group was also divided into a training set for transfer learning on the replication dataset (ADRC-CU-tl; n = 225)"

rci6_sex.detail: Sex breakdown for training subsets (ADNI-CU-train and ADRC-CU-tl) is not reported; only overall CU group sex ratios are provided in Table S1 (ADNI-CU: 205M:229F; ADRC-CU: 127M:174F)

rci7_age.detail: Age statistics for training subsets not reported; model-1 min/max inferred from one-hot encoding vector (44 positions, range 47-91 years) described in SM4.3; overall CU group ages are ADNI-CU: 71.5±7.2, ADRC-CU: 68.2±7.3 (Table S1) but these correspond to the overall phase, not training subset specifically
rci7_age.supporting_text: "each subject had an age vector with 44 positions, where each position corresponds to a year within the range of 47-91 years"
